status: clinical and functional ranges from the verified table (research 2026-11-22, kb/functional-anatomy.md + human_joint_table.json); stylized tier is a studio heuristic

angle_convention.measured_as: anatomical angle of the child segment relative to the parent segment, 0 = neutral (anatomical position); flexion positive
angle_convention.projection_2d: a structure maps each 2D channel to (joint, movement, sign, zero_offset): anatomical = sign * (relative_2d - zero_offset). Joints whose 2D sign can invert with axial rotation (elbow seen in a 3/4 view) declare flip_policy 'through_neutral'.

spine.notes: bending is distributed over many vertebrae; a single-point bend is an error

shoulder.notes: 180 deg of arm elevation is about 120 glenohumeral + 60 scapular

elbow.notes: never bends backward beyond a few degrees; nearly straight but not locked at impacts

forearm.notes: not visible as a 2D angle; changes hand/weapon orientation

flex.status: verified; stylized widened because a 2D wrist angle mixes flexion, deviation and forearm rotation

knee.preferred_bend: knee forward of the hip-ankle line (the shin folds backward)
knee.notes: never bends forward (backward-knee is an error for humans)

dorsiflex.status: verified (CDC passive mean; other charts give ~20 deg dorsiflexion)

segments_mass.source: Dempster/Winter style approximation (to be verified by the biomechanics research)

coupled_rules.what: raising the arm above about 30 deg moves the shoulder joint (scapula) up and rotates it
coupled_rules.check_2d: when the upper arm points above shoulder height, the shoulder joint shift must rise; ratio ~2:1 arm:scapula

coupled_rules.what: large trunk flexion is shared between spine and hips
in throws/strikes, peak angular speed moves hips -> trunk -> shoulder -> elbow -> wrist
elbow not fully locked (0 deg) at an impact

tiers.functional: range typically USED in everyday tasks - informative, never a limit (a straight arm at an impact is outside it and correct)
tiers.stylized: studio allowance for exaggeration (hard for stylised characters); heuristic

sources_table: ../../docs or kb: human_joint_table.json (ids LUTT, CDC_ROM, GATES2016, MORREY1981, RYU1991, NAMDARI2012, HYODO2017, ROWE2000, ESOLA1996)
